entries.german:
Wetzel der Marschall von Blidegg verzichtet zugunsten des Klosters St. Gallen auf seine Ansprüche an ein Käselehen.

Ich Wetzil der marschalch a) von Blidegge 1 rittir tůn kunt allen, die disin brief sehint odir iemir ho erint lesin, das ich || hatte ein ansprache gegin minim herrin abt Heinrich von sante Gallin 2 vnd b) gegin dem gotshus vmbe kaese lehin, || des han ich mich irvarn vnd irkenne mich o vch, das ich inkein reht hatte daran, vnd han mich inzigin fur mich || vnd fur alle min erbin in minis herrin hant des vorginandin abt Heinrichis an des gotshus stat allir der ansprache vnd allis des rehtis, des ich ie giwan odir ie hatte gegin dem gotshus zi sante Gallin von des kaeslehins wegin, vnd darumbe, das min herre abt Heinrich, der hieuor gischribin ist, vnd das gotshus zi sante Gallin von mir vnd von allen minen erbin vnd minen nahkomin hinnanhin iemir me ledig si vmbe das selbe kaeslehin, darumbe so gib ich dem gotshuse disin brief mit minim insigil bisigilt zi einim staetin vrkunde allir der dinge, so hie gischribin ist. Dis bischah vnd wart dise brief gebin zi sante Gallin, do man zalte von gottis giburte druzehinhundirt jar, darnah in dem sibindin jare, an dem naehstin vritage vor sant Thomas tult, da zigegin warin her Rv odolf von Willer 3, her V olrich von Lochin 4, her Johans von Lutirberg 5 rittir, Eglolf von Rosinberg 6, Heinrich der Ome, Eglolf sin brůdir 7, Heinrich der Lo vwe von Zukinriet 8, V olrich Lo vpach vnd andir bidirbe lute ginůge.

Siegel: Siegel schildf. 4/ca. 4,3 cm, +S.WEZZILONIS.. .CI.DE.BLIDE... (Abb. Geneal. Handbuch II, S. 99, Tf.X/4).
entries.english:
Wetzel von Blidegg, Marschall, renounces in favor of the monastery of St. Gallen his claims to a cheese fief.

I, Wetzel von Blidegg, Marschall, Ritter, make known to all who see or ever hear read this document that I had a claim against my lord Abbot Heinrich of St. Gallen and the monastery concerning a cheese fief. I have looked into the matter and acknowledge that I had no right to it. On behalf of myself and all my heirs, I have renounced into the hands of my lord, the aforementioned Abbot Heinrich, on behalf of the monastery, every claim and right that I ever acquired or held against the monastery of St. Gallen on account of that cheese fief. So that my lord Abbot Heinrich, named above, and the monastery of St. Gallen may henceforth forever be free of any claim concerning that same cheese fief from me, my heirs, or my successors, I give this sealed document to the monastery as lasting confirmation of everything written here. This took place and the document was issued at St. Gallen in the year 1307 from the birth of Christ, on the Friday immediately before St. Thomas's feast. Present were Lord Rudolf von Willer; Lord Volrich von Loch; Lord John von Luterberg, Ritter; Egilolf von Rosenberg; Heinrich the Omin and his brother Eglolf; Heinrich Lang von Zuckenriet; Volrich Loupach; and many other worthy people.

Seal: shield-shaped, about 4 by 4.3 cm, inscribed +S.WEZZILONIS.. .CI.DE.BLIDE... (illustrated in Genealogisches Handbuch II, p. 99, plate X/4).
